title: NIMBY Rails
provenance: Reported by iljajj (highball-db#689, 2026-10-25), Apple M5, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.22, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, DXMT environment, msync, rated 4 of 5 after a 7-minute session. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Reported playable on the default engine with DXMT on an M5 after a short session. The game's speed indicator sits under the MacBook's notch, and moving around the map is hard with only a trackpad. Nothing was measured here.

knownIssues.symptom: The game speed indicator is hidden under the notch on a MacBook
knownIssues.cause: the game draws its interface up to the top edge of the screen
